title: 第15章 秘密暴露第16章 丰厚奖励
content_zh:
看着叶霄尘和林清瑶打情骂俏的模样，大长老叶鸿炎的脸色稍稍缓和。
只要林家不和王家联姻，一切都还有转圜的余地。
但王富贵的脸色却阴沉的可怕，那双小眼睛里闪烁着危险的光芒。
突然，王富贵像是想起了什么，目光如刀般射向叶霄尘，
没错，叶霄尘应该是一个不能用玄气的废物才对，
可是，他是从哪里取出来的丹药呢？
虽然他刚才没察觉到玄气波动，但叶霄尘确实没有从怀中取丹药的动作，
叶霄尘更像是从储物戒指中，凭空变出来的一般。
为了印证自己的猜想，他暗中运转玄气，探查起叶霄尘的修为。
只是一瞬间，王富贵就察觉到了异常——这个所谓的体内竟然有玄气流转！
虽然这股玄气晦涩难明，但确确实实存在！
果然！
王富贵猛地拍案而起，脸上的肥肉都在颤抖，
我就说你从哪里取出来的丹药！
原来你早就能够修炼了！
议事厅内顿时一片哗然。
大长老叶鸿炎和林震山的不敢置信的瞪大了眼睛，看向王富贵想要确定他话的真实性；
林清瑶双眼充满爱慕的看向叶霄尘，他们之间的婚约只差临门一脚，如今叶霄尘能修炼，他们的婚约只会更加坚固；
叶龙和叶凡则是欣喜的笑了起来，在他们心中，近乎无所不能的少主，又怎么会解决不了自己修炼的问题呢！
叶霄尘则是一愣，他这才想起自己的敛息玉佩只能完全屏蔽玄罡境以下的探查。

对于玄罡境强者，虽然能隐藏具体修为，但无法完全掩盖修炼的事实。
不过看王富贵的反应，应该还没看穿自己的真实境界。
没错。
叶霄尘索性大方承认，
我爹已经解决了我的废体问题，现在我已经可以修炼了，只是修炼速度比较慢而已。
林震山闻言，眼中闪过惊讶之色：叶兄果然不愧是我们青云城不出世的天才！
不仅年纪轻轻就达到玄罡境巅峰，竟然还能解决先天废体的问题。
他意味深长地看了王富贵一眼，
要是真给叶兄几年时间，恐怕这青云城第一家族的名号，就要易主了。
王富贵脸上的笑容越发阴冷：是啊，只可惜...天妒英才啊。
这句话像一把尖刀，直插叶家众人心口。
大长老叶鸿炎的脸色瞬间阴沉如水，在某一瞬间，他甚至动了将两位家主留在叶家的念头，但这个不切实际的念头很快被他掐灭。
家中事务繁忙。
大长老强压怒火，声音冰冷，
既然林家主不再提退婚之事，那就不多留诸位了。
content_en:
Seeing Ye Xiaochen and Lin Qingyao flirting, the elder Ye Hongyan's expression softened slightly.
As long as the Lin family does not marry the Wang family, there is still room for change.
But Wang Fugui's face was gloomy and terrifying, and his small eyes shone with a dangerous light.
Suddenly, Wang Fugui seemed to remember something, and his eyes shot towards Ye Xiaochen like a knife,
That's right, Ye Xiaochen should be a waste who can't use Xuan Qi.
But where did he get the elixir from?
Although he didn't notice the fluctuation of profound energy just now, Ye Xiaochen did not make any move to take the elixir from his arms.
It was more like Ye Xiaochen was conjured out of thin air from a storage ring.
In order to confirm his conjecture, he secretly circulated Xuan Qi to explore Ye Xiaochen's cultivation level.
In just a moment, Wang Fugui noticed something unusual - there was mysterious energy flowing in this so-called body!
Although this mysterious energy is obscure and difficult to understand, it does exist!
really!
Wang Fugui suddenly slapped the table and stood up, the fat on his face was trembling.
I'll tell you where you got the elixir from!
It turns out that you have been able to practice for a long time!
There was an uproar in the conference hall.
The great elders Ye Hongyan and Lin Zhenshan widened their eyes in disbelief and looked at Wang Fugui to confirm the authenticity of his words;
Lin Qingyao looked at Ye Xiaochen with eyes full of admiration. The marriage contract between them was just a step away. Now that Ye Xiaochen can practice, their marriage contract will only become stronger;
Ye Long and Ye Fan laughed happily. In their hearts, how could the almost omnipotent young master not be able to solve their own cultivation problems!
Ye Xiaochen was stunned for a moment, and then he remembered that his breath-containing jade pendant could only completely block detection below the Xuan Gang realm.
For those who are strong in the Xuangang Realm, although they can hide their specific cultivation level, they cannot completely cover up the fact of their cultivation.
But judging from Wang Fugui's reaction, he probably hasn't seen through his true realm yet.
That's right.
Ye Xiaochen simply admitted it generously,
My father has solved the problem of my wasted body, and now I can practice cultivation, but the cultivation speed is relatively slow.
When Lin Zhenshan heard this, a look of surprise flashed in his eyes: Brother Ye is indeed an unparalleled genius in our Qingyun City!
Not only did he reach the peak of the Xuangang Realm at a young age, but he was also able to solve the problem of an inborn body.
He gave Wang Fugui a meaningful look,
If Brother Ye is really given a few years, I am afraid that the title of the first family in Qingyun City will change hands.
The smile on Wang Fugui's face became colder and colder: Yes, it's a pity... God is jealous of Yingcai.
These words were like a sharp knife, piercing the hearts of everyone in the Ye family.
The face of the great elder Ye Hongyan suddenly turned gloomy. At a certain moment, he even entertained the idea of ​​leaving the two family heads in the Ye family, but this unrealistic idea was quickly extinguished by him.
Things are busy at home.
The great elder suppressed his anger and his voice was cold,
Since the head of the Lin family no longer mentions breaking off the engagement, there will be no more seats left for you.
